# IAIS Advanced Ultrasonic Inspection

Official information site for advanced ultrasonic NDT services by IAIS India and IAIS UAE.

## Core services
- TOFD — Time of Flight Diffraction
- PAUT — Phased Array Ultrasonic Testing
- TFM — Total Focusing Method
- FMC — Full Matrix Capture

## Primary regions
- IAIS UAE: Musaffah Industrial Area, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates; i@iaisuae.com
- IAIS India Group HQ: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India; +91 93841 27579; i@iaisindia.com
